avoid_supplements.name: Ephedra/Ma huang
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct antagonism of clonidine's alpha-2 effects; risk of acute hypertensive crisis and rebound hypertension
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; counsel patient to avoid all ephedrine-containing products

avoid_supplements.name: Yohimbine
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Alpha-2 antagonist; directly opposes clonidine mechanism and can precipitate severe hypertension and tachycardia

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP2D6 and CYP1A2 inducer; reduces clonidine plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if unavoidable, monitor blood pressure closely and adjust clonidine dosing

caution_supplements.name: Licorice root
caution_supplements.mechanism: May cause sodium retention and potassium loss, potentially reducing antihypertensive efficacy and increasing fluid retention
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; monitor blood pressure and electrolytes; limit intake

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May increase sympathetic tone and modestly elevate blood pressure, potentially counteracting clonidine effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure response; advise moderate use only

caution_supplements.name: Caffeine-containing supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Sympathomimetic effects may partially antagonize alpha-2 agonism and increase heart rate variability
caution_supplements.action: Counsel moderation; monitor blood pressure and heart rate

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excess sodium may reduce antihypertensive efficacy and increase fluid retention
caution_foods.action: Recommend dietary sodium restriction consistent with hypertension management guidelines

caution_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheese, cured meats, fermented products)
caution_foods.mechanism: Clonidine may alter catecholamine metabolism; excessive tyramine intake could theoretically increase hypertensive risk
caution_foods.action: No strict restriction needed but advise moderation and monitor for blood pressure changes

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and signs of rebound hypertension (especially if abruptly discontinued). Assess for CNS depression and dry mouth; counsel on medication adherence to prevent dangerous blood pressure fluctuations.
